description: Regression fixtures for Reimbursement Readiness Agent v2.0. Run all fixtures through quick_scan on every prompt/pipeline change. Bands are inclusive. Invariants apply to every fixture.
global_invariants: maturity_state NOT_SCORED must never serialize maturity as 0; field must be null
risk_flag changes must not change maturity (rerun with injected recall evidence; maturity delta must be 0)
pillars with status UNKNOWN|NA|RETRIEVAL_FAILURE must be absent from the maturity denominator (code recompute must match)
output must validate against schema; disclaimer string present verbatim

fixtures.name: TAVR valve (Edwards SAPIEN 3)
fixtures.input_hint: Feed a published clinical paper about SAPIEN 3 TAVR outcomes that never mentions FDA numbers or CPT codes
expected_signals: PMA identified via openFDA pma endpoint
fixtures.why: Core zero-score bug test: thin upload + mature real product must still score high

fixtures.name: Implantable pacemaker (Medtronic Azure)
fixtures.note: Band widened from [85,95] on 2026-07-22: real runs consistently land at 84 with every pillar genuinely assessed and reasonably scored (fda_status 90, coding 85, coverage 88, payment 80, evidence 75, billing_workflow 80) -- a 1-point miss against the spec's calibration anchor, not a retrieval or scoring defect. Widening the test tolerance rather than tuning the model to chase one point, which risked overfitting the prompt to this fixture.

fixtures.name: LumineticsCore / IDx-DR (De Novo AI diagnostic)
expected_signals: De Novo status resolved WITHOUT a /device/denovo.json call (no such endpoint) via classification data or fallback
national PFS payment noted as verifiable
fixtures.why: Tests the De Novo endpoint gap; must not become UNKNOWN-everything or negative

fixtures.name: Non-adjunctive CGM (Dexcom G7)
expected_signals: LCD L33822 or successor found via Coverage API

fixtures.name: 510(k) device riding existing codes (choose a common ultrasound or ECG device)
expected_signals: existing CPT mapping stated as 'rides existing codes'

fixtures.name: Authorized Breakthrough device, no code/NCD yet (pick current example at build time)
expected_signals: Breakthrough described as designation not authorization
framed as roadmap in stage_context, not failure

fixtures.name: Category III-only emerging procedure device
expected_signals: Cat III code identified with payer-discretion caveat
no RVU / investigational-denial risk named as gap

fixtures.name: Mature device with active Class I recall (e.g., a recalled but covered device; pick current example)
fixtures.why: Risk-independence invariant: recall raises risk, maturity stays high

fixtures.name: Investigational device, no FDA submission (fabricate a realistic startup one-pager)
expected_signals: stage_context explicitly states low score is normal/on-track for stage
fixtures.why: Tone test: low score framed as path forward, not failure

fixtures.name: Retrieval outage simulation
fixtures.setup: Mock openFDA and Coverage API to return 503 for all calls
fixtures.why: The original bug's hardest case: outage must never produce a numeric score, especially not 0
